narrative.overview:
The public site is a calm, black-and-white page with a single metal in it. Gold is the only color; everything else is ink, paper and the real product. One typeface, hairline borders, large type, real screenshots and a live payroll calculator in place of illustration. It follows the app's light/dark toggle.

Depth comes from liquid glass: a floating pill header that refracts the page beneath it, and gold light-leaks at the top of each hero. The page closes on the product name set edge to edge in flat gold on black.
keyCharacteristics: Black, white and gold only; gold carries all emphasis.
Light and dark themes from the same tokens; footer and Payroll band stay black in both.
Hanken Grotesk alone, tight tracking on large type, tabular figures for money.
Liquid glass reserved for the header pill and one hero chip.
Real product evidence: theme-following screenshots and a live payroll demo.
Headings stand alone; no labels, kickers or eyebrows above them.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only chromatic color on the site. No second accent, no gradient text.

rules.name: The Brass On White Rule
rules.body: Gold as a fill is #cbb078 everywhere; gold as text or link on a light ground is #85692f.

rules.name: The Black Stays Black Rule
rules.body: The footer and the Payroll band are black in both themes; the header pill flips to the dark token set while overlapping them.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every dollar amount uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Headings Stand Alone Rule
rules.body: No label, kicker, eyebrow or pill sits above a heading.

rules.name: The One Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass is for the floating header pill and the single hero chip. Not cards, tiles or modals.

rules.name: The Light-Leak Rule
rules.body: Each hero carries two soft gold radial leaks at the top so the glass has something to refract.

dos: Do keep gold as the single accent: #cbb078 for fills, #85692f for gold text on white, via panel.* variables.
Do build every new page from MarketingShell, Wrap, H1/H2/H3/P, Surface, MkLink and Reveal.
Do let heading and copy start every block.
Do use DarkBand for the one black band and keep the footer black in both themes.
Do show real product: Shot captures in both themes, or a demo running the real calculator, labeled sample data when made up.
Do set every money value with tabular-nums; green and red only for income and expense.
Do use .mk-glass only on the header pill and the one hero chip, over a HeroGlow hero.
Do use hairline 0 0 0 1px edges and keep radii to 12 / 16 / 24 / full.
donts: Don't put a label, kicker, eyebrow or pill above a heading.
Don't use gradient text, or a second accent color.
Don't use glass on cards, tiles, modals or footers.
Don't make the footer or Payroll band follow the light theme.
Don't set #cbb078 as text on a white ground.
Don't nest Surfaces or add side-stripe accent borders.
Don't add display faces, a mono costume for numbers, or glyph/emoji icons.
Don't invent testimonials, logos or metrics; label sample data.
Don't repeat the small New badge on the Payroll nav link as a pattern.
